description: salted maple peanut butter oat cookies 🌟 (refined sugar free as well!!) guys these turned out so perfect the texture is EXACTLY how i love  Recipe 👩‍🍳 180g oats TOTAL!! : separate about 3 tbsp to keep whole, blend the rest into out flour  Pinch of salt 1/2 tsp baking powder 115g maple syrup  1 small egg 1 heaped tbsp of peanut butter (NOT the runny kind!!) 45g olive oil Any other add ins of choice (choc chips, cinnamon, nuts etc!) Flaky salt to top Bake at 180c (preheated, w the fan on) for 15-18 min; until golden brown 🍁 Let them cool for AT LEAST 20 min !!  #recipe #healthyrecipes #oatflour #bakewithme #healthycookies
